summary.zh: 先挂莱特与莱卡恩条件，雨果连携接决算；2影才开放Q后EX。
summary.en: Set up Lighter and Lycaon, then Chain into Totalize; M2 enables Ultimate into EX.

conditions.zh: 基础技能方案，不含莱卡恩潜能觉醒；实际失衡与命中优先于动作顺序。
conditions.en: Base-kit route without Lycaon Potential Awakening; actual Stun and hits take priority over the sequence.

conditions.zh: 雨果普通决算会结束失衡；0/1影不默认Q和EX连续两次。
conditions.en: Ordinary Totalize ends Stun; M0/M1 does not assume both Ultimate and EX in one window.

conditions.zh: 站位可调整；莱特80士气的自身快支仍需真实触发。
conditions.en: Slots can vary; Lighter’s own 80-Morale Quick Assist must actually trigger.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 雨果双击破（1.7）

objective.en: Prepare resistance reduction, Morale and Collapse.

input.zh: 有能量时发动强化特殊技并命中。
input.en: Use EX when energy allows and land it.

trigger.zh: 减抗需要刷新，且能量足够。
trigger.en: Ice RES reduction needs refreshing and energy is sufficient.

complete.zh: 确认EX命中；若目标已失衡，同时检查莱卡恩的失衡倍率条件。
complete.en: Verify the EX hit; if already Stunned, also check Lycaon’s Stun-multiplier condition.

reason.zh: EX减抗与命中失衡敌人的额外能力是两项条件。
reason.en: EX resistance reduction and hitting a Stunned target are separate conditions.

fallback.zh: 无能量可用真实招架后的支援突击补减抗；没有机会就先普攻，不虚构减抗。
fallback.en: Without energy, a real Defensive Assist into Follow-Up can refresh it; otherwise use Basics without assuming reduction.

title.en: Build Daze with Lycaon’s charged Basics

input.zh: 分段长按普攻，完成蓄力后松开并衔接下一段。
input.en: Hold each Basic stage to charge, release, then continue.

trigger.zh: 敌人未失衡；莱特士气尚未准备好或需要继续累积失衡。
trigger.en: Target is not Stunned; Lighter is not ready or more Daze is needed.

complete.zh: 按实际失衡条与莱特士气决定何时换人；遇攻击先处理。
complete.en: Read the actual Daze and Morale gauges; defend against incoming attacks.

reason.zh: 双击破轮流准备，不能把固定三次蓄普当作必然失衡。
reason.en: The Stun agents share setup; no fixed number of charged Basics guarantees Stun.

fallback.zh: 快失衡时优先确认莱特溃败已挂、雨果有EX能量或终结技可用。
fallback.en: Near Stun, check Lighter’s Collapse and Hugo’s available EX energy or Ultimate.

title.en: At 80 Morale, enter with Lighter’s Quick Assist

input.zh: 士气达到80后换入莱特；确认实际快速支援，再长按普攻。
input.en: At 80 Morale, bring Lighter in; confirm the real Quick Assist, then hold Basic.

trigger.zh: 真实士气≥80；莱特此时换入前台能触发自身快支。
trigger.en: Actual Morale is at least 80 and his next entry triggers his own Quick Assist.

complete.zh: 快支动作完成，直接衔接第五段；尚未命中不能计入增益。
complete.en: Finish the assist and connect Basic 5; no buff is credited before hits.

reason.zh: 此入口来自莱特自身士气机制，不把普通切入假称快支。
reason.en: This entry comes from Lighter’s own Morale mechanic; an ordinary switch is not mislabeled Quick Assist.

fallback.zh: 未满80先继续队友准备；若普通切入则按实际招式接第五段，不假定已进入喷发。
fallback.en: Below 80, continue teammate setup. After an ordinary entry, use a legal Basic-5 route without assuming Burst.

title.zh: 喷发连拳，终结一击再交棒
title.en: Finish the Morale-Burst punches before switching

input.zh: 80士气以上进入第五段，连点或长按打出刺拳，完成终结一击。
input.en: Enter Basic 5 with at least 80 Morale; tap or hold for the punches and finish the final strike.

trigger.zh: 士气喷发实际启动，目标可持续命中。
trigger.en: Morale Burst actually starts and the target remains hittable.

complete.zh: 确认喷发中的轻拳/刺拳命中、昂扬实际叠层，终结一击命中施加溃败。
complete.en: Verify Burst punches and actual Elation stacks, then land the finisher for Collapse.

reason.zh: 冰火减抗、昂扬、延长失衡各有命中条件；提前切走不能当全部完成。
reason.en: Resistance reduction, Elation and extended Stun have hit requirements; an early switch cannot complete them automatically.

fallback.zh: 中断后按剩余士气重新检查；没打中终结一击就不计溃败。
fallback.en: After interruption, recheck remaining Morale; no finisher hit means no Collapse credit.

objective.zh: 双击破交替准备，由莱卡恩落实失衡命中。
objective.en: Alternate Stun setup and secure Lycaon’s Stunned-target hit.

prep.zh: 莱特效果未完成时先补；敌人已经失衡则直接转爆发，不重演准备。
prep.en: Finish missing Lighter effects first; if already Stunned, go to burst rather than replaying setup.

objective.zh: 连携取得回响，再按影画决算。
objective.en: Gain Reverberation through Chain, then Totalize according to Mindscape.

title.zh: 先确认莱卡恩命中过失衡目标
title.en: Confirm Lycaon’s hit on the Stunned target

input.zh: 若尚未满足，莱卡恩用可用攻击命中已失衡目标；已经满足就跳过。
input.en: If missing, land an available Lycaon attack on the already Stunned target; skip if already satisfied.

trigger.zh: 目标已失衡，且莱卡恩额外能力的命中条件尚未完成。
trigger.en: The target is Stunned and Lycaon’s Additional Ability hit is still missing.

complete.zh: 确认额外失衡倍率实际生效，再进入雨果可用的连携。
complete.en: Verify the extra Stun multiplier, then take Hugo’s available Chain.

reason.zh: 打入失衡与对失衡敌人的命中要实际核对，不因队伍存在莱卡恩就计入。
reason.en: Check causing Stun and hitting a Stunned target separately; Lycaon’s mere presence is insufficient.

fallback.zh: 已经生效不重复占窗口；没有雨果连携提示就依真实状态处理，不创造提示。
fallback.en: Do not spend the window repeating an active condition; absent Hugo Chain prompts are not invented.

title.zh: 雨果连携命中，取得暗渊回响
title.en: Land Hugo’s Chain for Dark Abyss Reverberation

input.zh: 实际连携提示可选雨果时选择雨果。
input.en: Choose Hugo when the actual Chain prompt offers him.

trigger.zh: 目标真实失衡；莱特、莱卡恩需要的命中条件已检查。
trigger.en: The target is actually Stunned and the Stun agents’ hit conditions have been checked.

complete.zh: 连携实际命中、暗渊回响出现后，尽快选择本轮决算。
complete.en: After the Chain hits and Reverberation appears, choose this window’s Totalize promptly.

reason.zh: 作者建议连携取得自增益，再消耗剩余失衡时间；不为凑固定连携数拖延。
reason.en: The author prepares the self-buff through Chain before spending remaining Stun; no fixed Chain count is forced.

fallback.zh: 无连携提示就不执行；确认雨果是否通过实际打失衡取得回响，再决定输出。
fallback.en: Without a Chain prompt, skip it. Check whether Hugo actually caused Stun and gained Reverberation instead.

title.en: M2 branch: Ultimate without ending Stun

input.zh: 雨果终结技就绪时发动，保留前台等终结一击命中。
input.en: Use Hugo’s ready Ultimate and remain on field through its finisher.

trigger.zh: 雨果≥2影，终结技就绪，目标仍失衡且回响有效。
trigger.en: Hugo M2+, Ultimate ready, target still Stunned and Reverberation active.

complete.zh: 终结一击在失衡中命中触发决算；M2保留失衡，继续检查EX能量和剩余窗口。
complete.en: The finisher hits during Stun to Totalize. M2 preserves Stun; recheck EX energy and the remaining window.

reason.zh: 只有2影以后才把Q→EX作为同轮双决算分支。
reason.en: Only M2+ gets this same-window Ultimate-to-EX Totalize branch.

fallback.zh: 终结技未好就跳过；命中前目标已恢复时不计决算，返回准备。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable; if Stun ended before impact, do not credit Totalize and return to setup.

title.zh: EX决算落地，回到击破循环
title.en: Land EX Totalize, then restart the Stun cycle

input.zh: 有能量时点按强化特殊技，等终结一击实际命中。
input.en: Press EX with enough energy and let the final hit land.

trigger.zh: 目标在终结一击命中时仍失衡；雨果有能量且回响有效。
trigger.en: The target must still be Stunned on the final hit; Hugo has energy and active Reverberation.

complete.zh: 决算实际触发后失衡结束，重新读失衡条再交击破队友。
complete.en: After actual Totalize, Stun ends; reread Daze and hand back to a Stun teammate.

reason.zh: 零影基础每轮选择EX或就绪的Q之一；普通决算会结束失衡，不能无条件接第二次。
reason.en: At M0, choose EX or a ready Ultimate for the window. Ordinary Totalize ends Stun, so a second is not automatic.

fallback.zh: EX没能量但Q已就绪时可用Q替代本步；0/1影Q决算后直接回循环，不再强接EX。
fallback.en: If EX lacks energy but Ultimate is ready, substitute Ultimate. At M0/M1, return to the loop after its Totalize rather than forcing EX.

signal.zh: 决算已落地且可切人时回莱卡恩。
signal.en: Return to Lycaon after Totalize lands and switching is available.

prep.zh: 莱卡恩必须命中过已经失衡的目标；若他人打失衡，先补这次命中。
prep.en: Lycaon must hit an already Stunned target; if someone else caused Stun, supply that hit first.

prep.zh: 0/1影只执行一种决算；2影Q后仍须检查EX资源与失衡是否还在。
prep.en: At M0/M1 use one Totalize. After M2 Ultimate, EX still needs energy and a remaining Stun window.

text.zh: 2影仅让终结技决算不结束失衡；EX决算仍结束，先Q后EX才是本分支。
text.en: M2 preserves Stun only for Ultimate Totalize; EX still ends it, so this branch uses Ultimate first.

text.zh: 6影EX末击也能对非失衡敌人决算；本队保留失衡爆发主线，未把所有普通攻击都算成决算。
text.en: At M6 the EX finisher can Totalize outside Stun. This route keeps the Stun-burst focus and does not label every Basic as Totalize.

text.zh: 莱特1影增强溃败，仍必须让喷发终结一击命中。
text.en: Lighter M1 strengthens Collapse, but its Burst finisher must still hit.

text.zh: 雨果专武需EX、连携或终结技实际造成冰伤触发；确认短增益覆盖决算。
text.en: Hugo’s signature requires actual Ice damage from EX, Chain or Ultimate; check that Totalize falls inside its short buff.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.莱卡恩先补减冰抗: 强化特殊技命中，补冰抗降低
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.莱卡恩蓄普推进失衡: 分段长按普攻，蓄力打失衡
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.80士气后，莱特快支接第五段: 士气达到80后让莱特入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.喷发连拳，终结一击再交棒: 普攻第五段连打，等最后一击
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.先确认莱卡恩命中过失衡目标: 用莱卡恩命中已失衡目标
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.2影分支：先终结技，保留失衡: 2影分支：先放终结技，等最后一击命中
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.EX决算落地，回到击破循环: 点强化特殊技，等最后一击命中

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.80士气以上进入第五段，连点或长按打出刺拳，完成终结一击。: 士气至少80时接普攻第五段，继续连点或长按普攻打刺拳，等最后一击命中。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.若尚未满足，莱卡恩用可用攻击命中已失衡目标；已经满足就跳过。: 若莱卡恩还没命中过这轮失衡目标，点普攻命中一次即可；已经命中过就跳过。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.雨果终结技就绪时发动，保留前台等终结一击命中。: 雨果自己的终结技就绪时按终结技，保持在场，等最后一击命中。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.有能量时点按强化特殊技，等终结一击实际命中。: 有能量时点按强化特殊技，等最后一击命中再交棒。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1161: 先看士气；士气不足时按当前普攻连段推进，达到80并实际进入第五段才连打刺拳。

114100001: 走蓄力普攻路线：每段按住至蓄力完成再松开衔接，不按固定次数解锁强化特殊技。
For this charged Basic route hold and release each charged hit; there is no fixed tap count to unlock EX.
116100001: 本步需要接到普攻第五段后连点或长按打刺拳；从快支直达第五段时不用从第一段重打。
Continue or hold Basic from hit 5 for the punches. If Quick Assist already linked to hit 5, do not restart from hit 1.
116100010: 快支后点按或长按普攻，可直接接第五段；本路线要打刺拳才接，不必先点五次。
After Quick Assist, tap or hold Basic for direct hit 5 when following the punches route. No five preliminary taps.

1161: 士气不足可用普攻积累；达到80且接上第五段才连点或长按普攻。
Use Basics if building Morale. Tap repeatedly or hold only when Morale reaches 80 and hit 5 is available.
